title.zh: 您可能想了解更多关于与维尼健康的合作
title.en: What you may want to know about working with VINNER Health

question.zh: 维尼健康是湿巾制造商吗？工厂在哪里？
question.en: Is VINNER Health a wet wipes manufacturer? Where is the factory?

paragraphs.zh: 维尼健康是一家专注湿巾研发、生产与销售的制造商。我们成立于2004年，总部位于广东省深圳市，工厂（分公司）位于湖北省黄冈市。
paragraphs.en: VINNER Health is a manufacturer specializing in the research, development, production and sale of wet wipes. Founded in 2004, we are headquartered in Shenzhen, Guangdong, with our factory (branch company) in Huanggang, Hubei, China.

paragraphs.zh: 我们从事湿巾与干巾的ODM、OEM与OBM，即我们为客户提供产品研发、合同制造服务，同时我们也提供旗下自有品牌的直接分销。
paragraphs.en: We provide ODM, OEM and OBM services for wet and dry wipes: product development and contract manufacturing for our customers, as well as direct distribution of our own brands.

question.zh: 维尼健康可以提供哪些资质与认证？
question.en: What qualifications and certifications does VINNER Health hold?

paragraphs.zh: 维尼健康具有消毒产品生产许可证、化妆品生产许可证，能够从事消毒类与个人清洁、护理类产品的生产。
paragraphs.en: VINNER Health holds production licenses for disinfection products and cosmetics, enabling us to manufacture disinfection, personal cleansing and care products.

paragraphs.zh: 消毒与医疗类产品方面，我们具有国际通用的医疗器械GMP资质（ISO13485）；化妆品类产品方面，我们具有国际通用的化妆品GMP资质（ISO22716），并同时符合美国FDA化妆品GMP指导准则。
paragraphs.en: For disinfection and medical products, we hold internationally recognized medical-device GMP qualifications (ISO 13485). For cosmetics, we hold internationally recognized cosmetics GMP qualifications (ISO 22716) and also comply with the U.S. FDA's cosmetics GMP guidelines.

paragraphs.zh: 此外，我们在劳工、环境与公司治理上，具有多项国际通用认证和审计报告。
paragraphs.en: We also hold multiple internationally recognized certifications and audit reports covering labor, the environment and corporate governance.

question.en: What is the minimum order quantity?

paragraphs.zh: 通常而言，合同制造产品MOQ为30,000–100,000包（根据不同产品而定）或一个独立的货柜。维尼健康自有品牌产品的分销则更加灵活。
paragraphs.en: The MOQ for contract-manufactured products is typically 30,000–100,000 packs, depending on the product, or one dedicated shipping container. Distribution of VINNER Health's own-brand products offers greater flexibility.

question.zh: 维尼健康的优势是什么？我为什么要选择维尼健康？
question.en: What are VINNER Health's strengths, and why should I choose you?

paragraphs.zh: 第一，就合规资质与管理体系而言，维尼健康是“大满贯”选手。我们的资质涵盖国内与全球通用的全品类湿巾，保障您的产品在制造环节的品质与合规；
paragraphs.en: First, VINNER Health offers a comprehensive range of compliance qualifications and management systems. Our qualifications cover all categories of wet wipes for domestic and international markets, supporting product quality and compliance throughout manufacturing.

paragraphs.zh: 第二，就湿巾研发技术而言，维尼健康具有二十年以上的湿巾研发经验与配方积累，并拥有独立的生物化学与研发实验室，保障您的产品达到最好的使用体验；
paragraphs.en: Second, we bring more than 20 years of wet-wipe R&D experience and formulation expertise, supported by independent biochemistry and R&D laboratories to deliver the best possible product experience.

paragraphs.zh: 第三，就工厂实力而言，维尼健康具有超过95%自动化率的生产线与最高8×40HQ的每日产能；
paragraphs.en: Third, our production lines have an automation rate of over 95%, with daily production capacity reaching up to eight 40-foot high-cube containers (8 × 40HQ).

paragraphs.zh: 第四，就信任成本而言，{{partners}}，我们自身与客户均以最高品质要求维尼的生产与物流环节，过往的履历有效降低了我们与客户的信任成本。
paragraphs.en: Fourth, {{partners}}. Both we and our customers hold VINNER's production and logistics to the highest quality standards. This track record helps reduce the effort required to establish trust with new customers.

question.en: How can I contact VINNER Health?

paragraphs.zh: 您可以直接通过官网的{{form}}发送您的需求，我们时刻会关注该表单；
paragraphs.en: You can submit your requirements through our website's {{form}}, which our team monitors regularly.

paragraphs.zh: 同时您也可以直接通过官网的{{contacts}}联系到我们的业务开发经理。
paragraphs.en: You can also reach our business development managers directly using the {{contacts}} listed on our website.
